description:
Tyranid vanguard forces have broken past the main battlelines to harass the T'au supply chains. The T'au forces must redirect support and extract critical intel before the location is overrun with Tyranids. 

Skari and Luka will be trying out a 1,000-point match for the first time in the 11th edition of Warhammer 40k.
